title: Twelve-month time-series momentum
author: arhancanli
rationale: An asset's own return over the past year has tended to predict its next month across asset classes. This holds the asset only while that return is positive.
risks: Sharp reversals at trend turns, known as momentum crashes, and long flat stretches in range-bound markets.
references: Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen (2012), Time Series Momentum, Journal of Financial Economics
